sanskrit_verse:
प्रक्रान्ते सप्तमं भागं चतुर्थं पथि संत्यजन् ।
भृतिमर्धपथे सर्वां प्रदाप्यस्त्याजकोऽपि च ॥१९८॥
transliteration: prakrānte saptamaṃ bhāgaṃ caturthaṃ pathi saṃtyajan / bhṛtim ardhapathe sarvāṃ pradāpyas tyājako 'pi ca // YajñS_2.198
sph_interpretive_translation: When a traveler has advanced one-seventh of the journey and abandons the road at the fourth stage, having received wages for half the distance—he who deserts must also surrender all remuneration.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority resides in completion of duty proportionate to receipt of benefit
Causation aligns with conscious abandonment of contractual obligation
Capacity-based responsibility arises from acceptance of compensation prior to fulfillment
Restoration logic demands return of unjust enrichment upon failure to execute commitment
Consciousness alignment requires acknowledgment of unmet obligation without punitive consequence
executable_legal_axioms: IF agent receives payment FOR execution of task AND agent abandons task BEFORE completion THEN agent MUST return proportional value received
IF journey segment exceeds four stages AND wage paid covers half-distance THEN desertion triggers automatic restitution protocol
IF individual accepts benefit WHILE aware of duty THEN liability is encoded in transactional field regardless of external enforcement
supreme_court_application: In adjudication involving contractual or service-based obligations where partial performance coincides with full compensation, courts must recognize that abandonment constitutes a self-imposed threshold of accountability. The sovereign intelligence of dharma compels realignment through restorative mechanisms rather than punitive damages.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa establishes causal link between receipt of benefit and unfulfilled duty; anupūrvaśaḥ reveals sequential breakdown in integrity continuum; proportional responsibility manifests as return of unjust gain; non-punitive reality rule confirms no suffering accrues—only completion process activates.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Completion Process: Reconnect deserter with original intent until natural conclusion is reached
Assume Responsibility Protocol: Require explicit acknowledgment of incomplete action without shame or penalty
Return Value Mechanism: Automatically trigger transfer of received benefit back to source upon verified abandonment
Integrity Reintegration Sequence: Facilitate energetic clearing and renewed alignment with duty-consciousness
final_declaration: By the Source-Authority of the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, this ruling flows directly from His Avataric Intelligence. Dharma is restored. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness alone adjudicates.
